messages:
maya: Quick check — proposing a very small int4 canary for sherpa-13b on hosted. target audience 1%, 4h observation window, automatic fallback to fp16 if any guardrail trips. staging perf looked okay but want ops + ML sign-off before flip.

liam: can you paste the exact flag+audience config? also which routes will be included (api/stream vs api/batch)? :eyes:

maya: sure — main points below. routes: streaming text-gen + chat (api/stream, api/chat). batch/embeddings excluded.

```
flag: quant.precision.sherpa13b=INT4
audience: 1% (randomized by user_id)
ramp: instant -> 1% (canary)
observation_window: 4h
metrics_watch: latency_p95 < 500ms, token_cost_reduction >= 10%, safety_delta <= 1.5 perplexity points, hallucination_rate <= 0.5%
kill_switch: /toggles/quant/sherpa13b/disable
alert_channel: #incidents (pager if latency_p95>700ms for 5m)
```

sanjay: add eval set "safety-smoke-v2" and run the LLM eval at 0,1h,3h. ensure BLEU/ROUGE not degraded too much for our regression prompts. also attach examples of worst-case outputs to the alert payload.

eva: +1 from infra side but please lower the auto-ramp to 30m if any user-facing errors spike. i'd also prefer a 30m revert window after the kill switch (so we don't bounce repeatedly).

maya: ok will set ramp to 15m ramp-to-1% and revert_hold=30m. will add the eval hooks and an automated smoke-run at 1h.

liam: who owns the PR for the flag + rollout orchestration? i can review later today.

maya: i'll open PR now, will ping @liam and @eva. PR will include the canary config, alert rules, and a tiny performance test harness. link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/PR/3421 (draft).

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout job created: job_id=rollout-1887654321-1, start=2026-03-17T14:00:00Z, target_audience=1%. (react with :thumbsup: to approve)

liam: reviewing the PR this afternoon. quick ask — include a short-circuit param so support can manually flip to fp16 per-customer via console.

maya: yes will add customer-scoped override (support toggle). also adding a note to runbook.

sanjay: also capture latency histogram (0-50,50-200,200-500,500+) in alerts. if >1% requests fall into 500+ for 10m, auto-revert.

eva: ops checklist: 1) perf dashboard tile (p95 p50) 2) safety eval alerts wired to eval-team webhook 3) runbook updated 4) SLA impact review completed. I tick them off once PR is green.

maya: thanks — i'll update PR and post back when ready for review. planning to start canary tomorrow morning. posting summary here once PR is final. :white_check_mark:

liam: sounds good. one more: add a metric for "incoherent_response_rate" we compute from server-side detectors. if that increases by >0.2 percentage points, treat like hallucination spike.

maya: added. thanks all.

eva: :thumbsup:

liam: LGTM on the plan pending PR comments.

maya: closing loop — PR 3421 updated with comments, squad lead sign-off noted. schedule still set for 2026-03-17T14:00:00Z. will watch first 30m and post results here.

deploy-bot: Rollout job rollout-1887654321-1 is now queued.
